function registerBatch(string cropName, string farmerName, string originIpfsHash) returns (uint256)
function markInTransit(uint256 batchId, string note, string ipfsHash)
function markAtVendor(uint256 batchId, string note, string ipfsHash)
function confirmDelivery(uint256 batchId, string note, string ipfsHash)
function getBatch(uint256 batchId) view returns (tuple(uint256 id, string cropName, address farmer, string farmerName, string originIpfsHash, uint256 createdAt, uint8 currentStage, bool exists))
function getHistory(uint256 batchId) view returns (tuple(uint8 stage, address actor, string note, string ipfsHash, uint256 timestamp)[])
event BatchRegistered(uint256 indexed batchId, address indexed farmer, string cropName)
event StageUpdated(uint256 indexed batchId, uint8 stage, address indexed actor, string note)
